SQL 140 needs public.tenant_wallet_funding_settings with tenant_id, auto_funding_enabled, funding_bank_account_id, funding_payment_method_id, funding_strategy, target_wallet_balance_cents, maximum_single_pull_cents, maximum_daily_pull_cents, require_payment_approval, authorization_accepted_at, authorization_accepted_by, authorization_version, updated_at (restored Supabase schema, supabase/migrations/20260828201816_*.sql), owned by checksops_admin, and the role checksops; the file itself raises sql140_table_missing, sql140_column_missing or sql140_role_missing otherwise. The WalletOps automatic funding save (save-tenant-wallet-funding-settings, saveTenantWalletFundingSettings in aws/functions/api/tenant-settings-handlers.mjs, #1524) runs, as checksops and after setting request.money_write, one INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (tenant_id) DO UPDATE ... RETURNING * naming tenant_id and the request's columns (authorization_accepted_at and authorization_accepted_by when a version is sent; updated_at on every update). The restored AWS databases gave checksops SELECT only on every table (aws/db-copy/sql/02_grant_readonly_application_role.sql) and no repository migration grants INSERT or UPDATE on this table, so on staging PostgreSQL refuses the save before row-level security (/aws/lambda/checksops-staging-api 2026-11-02 12:31:40Z: 403, permission denied for table tenant_wallet_funding_settings). Production's grants on this table are not recorded in this repository: the read-only inspect reads them. SQL 140 grants checksops column INSERT on the twelve columns the save inserts and column UPDATE on the twelve it updates; the table ACL, the policies aws_write_tenant_wallet_funding_settings (aws/rls/sql/24_complete_write_policies.sql: aws_can_write_tenant(tenant_id)), aws_select_tenant_wallet_funding_settings and SQL 136's aws_money_write_gate_*_tenant_wallet_funding_settings stay the authorization boundary and are not changed. If the read-only inspect finds every pinned line held it reports already_applied true and nothing is applied (the pin is then recorded as verified live, not applied). No later migration revokes these grants.
